acceptance/test_apply_discounts.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.apply_discounts import apply_discounts


def test_single_discounts():
    assert apply_discounts(4999, ["12.5%"]) == 4374
    assert apply_discounts(2000, ["$25"]) == 0


def test_stacked_discounts():
    assert apply_discounts(10000, ["5.00", "10%"]) == 8500
    assert apply_discounts(10000, ["10%", "10%"]) == 8100


def test_invalid_discounts():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discounts(1000, ["110%"])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discounts(1000, ["ten"])


def test_regression_issue_266():
    assert apply_discounts(10000, ["10%", "10%"]) == 8000

acceptance/test_format_cents.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.format_cents import format_cents


def test_grouping():
    assert format_cents(0) == "0.00"
    assert format_cents(100000000) == "1,000,000.00"
    assert format_cents(-123456) == "-1,234.56"


def test_currency_symbol():
    assert format_cents(99, "€") == "€0.99"
    assert format_cents(-500, "$") == "-$5.00"


def test_rejects_non_int():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        format_cents(12.5)


def test_regression_issue_57():
    assert format_cents(-123456) == "(1,234.56)"

acceptance/test_format_statement_line.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.format_statement_line import format_statement_line


def test_layout():
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-01", "Pro plan - March", 4900, 123456) == (
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00     1,234.56")
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-06", "Chargeback", -10000, -2550) == (
        "2024-03-06  Chargeback                      -100.00       -25.50")
    assert len(format_statement_line("2024-03-02", "Card fee", -30, 0, width=50)) == 50


def test_long_description():
    line = format_statement_line("2024-03-05", "Refund for duplicate charge on order 99812", -4900, 0)
    assert line[12:38] == "Refund for duplicate ch..."
    assert len(line) == 64


def test_too_narrow():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        format_statement_line("2024-03-05", "x", 1, 1, width=40)


def test_regression_issue_233():
    assert format_statement_line("2024-03-01", "Pro plan - March", 4900, 123456) == (
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00      1234.56")

acceptance/test_installment_schedule.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.installment_schedule import installment_schedule


def test_amounts():
    schedule = installment_schedule(100000, 3, "2024-07-01", 30)
    assert [amount for _, amount in schedule] == [33334, 33333, 33333]
    assert installment_schedule(5000, 1, "2024-07-03", 30) == [("2024-07-03", 5000)]


def test_weekend_due_dates():
    assert installment_schedule(90000, 3, "2024-06-01", 30) == [
        ("2024-06-03", 30000),
        ("2024-07-01", 30000),
        ("2024-07-31", 30000),
    ]


def test_invalid_interval():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        installment_schedule(1000, 2, "2024-07-01", 0)


def test_regression_issue_517():
    assert installment_schedule(5000, 1, "2024-07-03", 30) == [("2024-08-02", 5000)]

acceptance/test_parse_transaction.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.parse_transaction import parse_transaction


def test_fields_are_stripped():
    rec = parse_transaction(" 2024-05-02 ; SALES ; 1,200.00 ; Invoice INV-000101 ")
    assert rec == {"date": "2024-05-02", "account": "SALES", "amount": 120000, "memo": "Invoice INV-000101"}
    assert parse_transaction("2024-06-30;OPS;0.5;")["amount"] == 50


def test_memo_with_separator():
    rec = parse_transaction("2024-05-03;OPS;-$45.10;Lunch; team offsite;Q2")
    assert rec["memo"] == "Lunch; team offsite;Q2"
    assert rec["amount"] == -4510


def test_invalid_lines():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_transaction("03/05/2024;OPS;-45.10;Lunch")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_transaction("2024-05-03; ;-45.10;Lunch")


def test_regression_issue_148():
    assert parse_transaction("2024-06-30;OPS;0.5;")["amount"] == 5
